order_book: Our firm order book at 30th September stands at INR3,735 crores at quoted value and around INR4,300 crores at current market prices under the price variation clause.More importantly, it keeps growing while we execute it.
Adani Group entities are 43% of the order book, and we aim Adani's share of top line to a stated cap of 20% to 20% over time, with every Adani order placed at market price on a reverse auction basis.
Order inflow in H1 was INR2,217 crores against a revenue of INR1,722 crores, a book- to-bill of 1.29x after 1.63x in financial 2026.
guidance: I mean, also how much of you r FY28 revenue target is already backed by the existing orders or a visible pipeline?
Management: So as we mentioned earlier, the market value of our existing orders is around INR4,300 crores, and we are targeting to do almost INR2,500 crores in March.
capex: Copper capacity of 1,500 tons a month is live and is being scaled to 2,500.
The combined capacity of the project will be 84,5 00 tons.
risks: The industry is presently going through a cycle where quality is considerably compromised under the pressure of maintaining margins and volumes in B2C due to entry of newer players.
focus: That is the difference between a company riding a metal cycle and a company adding capacity, qualifications, and customers.
I am sure with being a dominant player, we shall be focusing on that market in a big way.
We are also focusing on EHV cables in a very big way, and we are now focusing on exports, and especially exports in medium voltage and extra high voltage.
